messages:
Aisha (AE): Quick sync 1 Ripcord wants a 3-week technical POC to swap CompetitorX -> Redwood. They need streaming parity, function-calls, and a security checklist. Can SE + SRE pair on this?

Ben (SE): I can lead. Ask: sanitized sample logs (200 examples), exact streaming frame format, and function schema. Will build a tiny shim to translate shapes.

Dana (Presales): They stream line-delimited JSON and rely on function-calling for lookups. Will request sanitized samples after NDA.

Chao (SRE): Security quick hits: IP allowlist, audit logs, SOC2 docs, KMS-managed keys. Client cert pinning and VPC peering -> Dedicated/Private.

Ben (SE): Plan: 1) shim maps passages->messages and function args to Redwood functions; 2) transform Redwood streaming deltas into their chunk frames; 3) run side-by-side for 48h to estimate token delta.

Aisha (AE): Pricing question: they expect ~1M tokens/day. Finance: hosted vs dedicated ballpark to help the pitch?

Chao (SRE): I'll provision a staging env and add two staging IPs for allowlist. infra-bot will post creds.

infra-bot: env created: ripcord-mini-poc. upload: s3://redwood-pocs/ripcord-mini/ (restricted). Ephemeral key issued.

Ben (SE): Smoke curl for streaming (example): curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"Be concise."}],"stream":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions

Aisha (AE): OK owners: Ben (SE) POC lead, Chao (SRE) infra, Dana presales/questionnaire, Aisha customer coord. Kickoff Monday. Post blockers here.
